explication: Google Style Guides is a reference collection: developers use its index to find language- and format-specific conventions, then consult the relevant guide. The repository also includes browser-side helpers for tables of contents, heading links, and guide-page preparation. The README documents guides hosted elsewhere as well as repository files; the graph focuses on local guide sources and does not infer how unsampled pages invoke the shared scripts.
